name: Tokikage
source:
"I want to give you a new place to live...in a wider world."

Part of a secret troupe among the vigilante corp of Takamagahara.
He's skilled with a sword and in martial arts. A bright youth with lots of energy.
An old childhood friend of the protagonist, he's friendly rivals with [url=/c49812]Yukinari[/url].
